title: Ansys Achieves TSMC Certifications for 7NM FinFET Plus Process Technology and Integrated Fan-Out with Memory on Substrate Advanced Packaging Technology

passages.note: Opening paragraphs, RedHawk and Totem N7+ certification. Ansys reports its two simulation applications certified for the N7+ process and identifies EUV-enabled features in that process. Tool certification precedes the attributed 2019 volume milestone.
